title: Control, steerability & effort
description: Rate your agreement with each statement about teaching the robot this way (1 = strongly disagree, 7 = strongly agree).

metadata.instrument: Study-defined control/steerability/effort scale (companion to NASA-TLX effort).
metadata.note: Effort items are complementary to the NASA-TLX effort subscale; 'effortful' is reverse-scored so higher composite = more perceived control.

items.prompt: I felt in control of what the robot learned.
I could express what I wanted the robot to do.
Teaching the robot this way took a lot of effort.
